airdrops.note: From the devnet faucet through RPC requestAirdrop, on 2026-09-24. First for the deploy, payer, treasury and issuer keys, retried with backoff and shrinking amounts (1, 0.5, 0.2, 0.1 SOL) from 06:12 to 06:40 UTC: 3 of 376 requests granted. Then for the deploy key alone, 1 SOL every 5 minutes from 06:41 to 09:37 UTC: 2 of 72 granted. All five came through Alchemy's public demo endpoint. The rest were refused: api.devnet.solana.com answered 224 times with 429, "You've either reached your airdrop limit today or the airdrop faucet has run dry"; Alchemy's endpoint 217 times with HTTP 429 and no body, and twice with "Internal error". In all: deploy 3.0 SOL, payer 0.2, treasury 0.1, issuer 0.
